description:
Most calorie calculators give you a number on day one and never touch it again. Your body adapts. Your targets should too.

CutEngine pulls data from your smartwatch and adjusts your calories and macros every day. Steps, workouts, sleep, HRV. If you already wear a watch that syncs to HealthKit, CutEngine turns that data into nutrition targets without you logging anything manually.

TRAIN + CUT
Open the app each morning and it tells you the plan. Training day or rest day. Cut or refeed. You know what to do before you eat your first meal.

CALORIES THAT MOVE WITH YOU
TDEE, deficit, and macros update daily based on what you actually did yesterday. Trained harder? Eat more. Slept poorly? The app accounts for it. Over time it learns your body's patterns and gets more precise.

BODY FAT TRACKING
Measure with a tape using the Navy Method. If you get a DEXA scan, CutEngine uses it to calibrate your daily readings so they stay accurate between scans.

THE CHECKLIST DIET
Pick your meals once. Eat them every day. Check them off. CutEngine is a compliance tool, not a meal planner. You bring the food choices, we make sure you follow through.

RECOVERY
Sleep and HRV data from your wearable show up as plain-language status: Well Rested, Good, Recovering, Rest Up, Ease Up. You don't need to interpret raw numbers.

CONSISTENCY
Seven dots show your last week of training and cardio. A rolling grade tells you where you stand: Building, On Track, Dialed, or Elite.

REST DAYS
Set your rhythm. 3 on, 1 off. 5 on, 2 off. Whatever works for you. CutEngine follows your pattern and tells you when to train, rest, or just do cardio.

FOR ALL PROTOCOLS
CutEngine supports a wide range of fitness goals and training approaches. Consult a healthcare professional for guidance specific to your situation.

WHAT THIS APP IS NOT
CutEngine does not log your food. It does not plan your meals for you. It gives you the right numbers and tells you if you're on track.
promotionalText: Daily adaptive calorie targets + structured protocol tracking. Manage your entire cut — targets, timeline, and protocol schedules — in one app.
whatsNew:
What's new in 1.0.1:

• AI Protocol Parser — the Protocol tab now uses on-device AI to intelligently parse and organize your supplement and nutrition inputs
• Compliance Reports — new weekly and monthly compliance views with export to image or PDF
• Compliance Predictions — machine learning model forecasts your adherence trends based on past behavior
• Supplement Notifications — per-supplement notification scheduling with interaction-risk alerts and time-sensitive delivery
• Protocol Improvements — Cycles section now surfaces in the Protocol tab; new dosing frequency picker for finer control
• Bug fixes and performance improvements
